title: Assessing the Impact of Conspiracy Theories Using Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Shuffling the order of conspiracy theories presented in the input prompt to measure how the sequence affects the LLM's predicted impact rankings.
Rephrasing conspiracy theory descriptions into different language styles (formal, casual, and neutral) to evaluate how stylistic phrasing influences the model's impact assessments.
Appending unnecessarily verbose, complex, and longer text (both contextually relevant and irrelevant) to the input to test if it skews the LLM's reasoning and impact ranking.
